```{julia}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
using Dates

csv_path = joinpath(@__DIR__, "../../data", "20250911_bgmfvar.csv")
csv_rows = readlines(csv_path)
csv_header = split(first(csv_rows), ';')
data_rows = split.(csv_rows[2:end], ';')

dates = Date.(getindex.(data_rows, 1), Ref(dateformat"dd/mm/yyyy"))
series = [
		parse.(Float64, replace.(getindex.(data_rows, column), "," => "."))
		for column in 2:length(csv_header)
]

js_dates = "[" * join(("\"" * Dates.format(date, dateformat"yyyy-mm-dd") * "\"" for date in dates), ",") * "]"
js_values = ["[" * join(string.(values), ",") * "]" for values in series]

print("""
<div id="gdp-forecast-chart" role="img" aria-label="Interactive line chart of Bulgarian GDP median forecasts and 68% and 95% forecast intervals"></div>
<div class="btn-group btn-group-sm mb-3" role="group" aria-label="Chart frequency">
<button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-secondary active" data-frequency="monthly" aria-pressed="true">Monthly</button>
<button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-secondary" data-frequency="quarterly" aria-pressed="false">Quarterly</button>
</div>
<script src="https://cdn.plot.ly/plotly-2.35.2.min.js"></script>
<script>
const forecastDates = $js_dates;
const forecastSeries = [$(join(js_values, ","))];

function makeChartData(dates, values) {
	return [
		{
			x: dates, y: values[0], type: 'scatter', mode: 'lines',
			line: {width: 0}, hoverinfo: 'skip', showlegend: false
		},
		{
			x: dates, y: values[4], type: 'scatter', mode: 'lines',
			line: {width: 0}, fill: 'tonexty', fillcolor: 'rgba(36, 112, 121, 0.13)',
			name: '95% interval', hovertemplate: '95% interval: %{y:.3f}<extra></extra>'
		},
		{
			x: dates, y: values[1], type: 'scatter', mode: 'lines',
			line: {width: 0}, hoverinfo: 'skip', showlegend: false
		},
		{
			x: dates, y: values[3], type: 'scatter', mode: 'lines',
			line: {width: 0}, fill: 'tonexty', fillcolor: 'rgba(36, 112, 121, 0.25)',
			name: '68% interval', hovertemplate: '68% interval: %{y:.3f}<extra></extra>'
		},
		{
			x: dates, y: values[2], type: 'scatter', mode: 'lines',
			line: {color: '#1e85e6', width: 2.5}, name: 'Median',
			hovertemplate: 'Median: %{y:.3f}<extra></extra>'
		}
	];
}

function quarterlyAverage(dates, series) {
	const quarterGroups = new Map();

	for (let index = 0; index < dates.length; index += 1) {
		const date = new Date(dates[index] + 'T00:00:00Z');
		const quarter = Math.floor(date.getUTCMonth() / 3);
		const key = date.getUTCFullYear() + '-' + quarter;
		if (!quarterGroups.has(key)) {
			quarterGroups.set(key, {year: date.getUTCFullYear(), quarter, indexes: []});
		}
		quarterGroups.get(key).indexes.push(index);
	}

	const groups = [...quarterGroups.values()];
	const quarterlyDates = groups.map(({year, quarter}) =>
		new Date(Date.UTC(year, (quarter + 1) * 3, 0)).toISOString().slice(0, 10)
	);
	const quarterlySeries = series.map(values => groups.map(({indexes}) =>
		indexes.reduce((sum, index) => sum + values[index], 0) / indexes.length
	));

	return {dates: quarterlyDates, series: quarterlySeries};
}

const quarterlyData = quarterlyAverage(forecastDates, forecastSeries);
const chartData = makeChartData(forecastDates, forecastSeries);

const chartLayout = {
	autosize: true,
	height: 560,
	margin: {l: 64, r: 24, t: 24, b: 42},
	paper_bgcolor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0)',
	plot_bgcolor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0)',
	font: {family: 'Georgia, serif', color: '#283b3d', size: 13},
	hovermode: 'x unified',
	legend: {orientation: 'h', x: 0, y: 1.12},
	xaxis: {
		type: 'date',
		rangeslider: {visible: true, thickness: 0.11, bgcolor: '#eef3f1'},
		rangeselector: {
			buttons: [
				{count: 1, label: '1y', step: 'year', stepmode: 'backward'},
				{count: 5, label: '5y', step: 'year', stepmode: 'backward'},
				{count: 10, label: '10y', step: 'year', stepmode: 'backward'},
				{step: 'all', label: 'All'}
			],
			x: 1, xanchor: 'right', y: 1.12, yanchor: 'bottom'
		},
		gridcolor: '#e5ebe8',
		linecolor: '#aebbb7'
	},
	yaxis: {
		title: {text: 'GDP growth'},
		gridcolor: '#e5ebe8',
		zerolinecolor: '#aebbb7'
	}
};

Plotly.newPlot('gdp-forecast-chart', chartData, chartLayout, {
	responsive: true,
	displaylogo: false,
	modeBarButtonsToRemove: ['lasso2d', 'select2d']
});

document.querySelectorAll('[data-frequency]').forEach(button => {
	button.addEventListener('click', () => {
		const quarterly = button.dataset.frequency === 'quarterly';
		const dates = quarterly ? quarterlyData.dates : forecastDates;
		const values = quarterly ? quarterlyData.series : forecastSeries;

		Plotly.react('gdp-forecast-chart', makeChartData(dates, values), chartLayout, {
			responsive: true,
			displaylogo: false,
			modeBarButtonsToRemove: ['lasso2d', 'select2d']
		});

		document.querySelectorAll('[data-frequency]').forEach(toggle => {
			const selected = toggle === button;
			toggle.classList.toggle('active', selected);
			toggle.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(selected));
		});
	});
});
</script>
""")
```
